content: Aseǧem ɣar umezwaru d usejjeɛ
Bulus, rrasul n Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ ɛlaḥsab řxaḍar n AREBBI, ɛlaḥsab lwaɛd n Tudart i din iǧan di Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
I Timutiyu, mmi iɛizzen: arḍa d arreḥmet d řehna zi AREBBI, Babatneɣ, u zi Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, Siditneɣ.
Acejjeɛ i Timutiyu
Necc ttqadiɣ AREBBI wenni umi ɛebdeɣ am řejdud inu s tnefsect tezdeg, am ttidareɣ cek břa qeṭṭu di tẓaǧitin inu ass d ǧiřet.
Weḥḥceɣ ad cek ẓareɣ, xmi ttfekkareɣ deg imeṭṭawen nnec u ttwaccureɣ s řefraḥet,
umi ttidareɣ di l’iman nnec břa nnifaq, l’iman nni tuɣa izeddɣen amezwar di ḥennac Luwis u deg yemmac Uniki, uca, aqa ssneɣ nican belli izdeɣ dayek ɛawed.
S uyenni ssɛeqřeɣ cek ad tessekkared tawhibt n AREBBI tenni dayek s webrid n wesrusi n ifassen inu xak.
Minzi AREBBI war d aneɣ iwci arruḥ n řɛurret, maca arruḥ n jjehd d tayri d utebbet.
S uya war ttseḍḥi ca ḥima ad tewced cchadet x Siditneɣ, u war ttseḍḥi zzayi necc, wenni d ameḥbus nnes, maca ksim marra řɣar di ṭṭweɛ n L’Injil s jjehd n AREBBI,
wenni aqa iwca aneɣ Tudart uca iřaɣa aneɣ-dd s třaɣit iqeddsen, war iǧi ɛlaḥsab řexdayem nneɣ, maca ɛlaḥsab řxaḍar nnes d arḍa nni i d aneɣ immewcen di Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ qbeř řweqt n zzmanat.
Aqa arḍa-ya ittwasseḍhar řexxu s uxecci n wenni d aneɣ itticen Tudart, Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, wenni tuɣa ibeḍřen řmewt uca isseḍhar Tudart war ifennin s L’Injil.
Zzayes ttwassgeɛɛdeɣ necc d ambarreḥ d rrasul d umseřmad n řegnus.
X ssibbet-a ɛawed ksiɣ armeḥ u war ttseḍḥiɣ ca, minzi ssneɣ man wen i zi ttamneɣ uca aqa ttwassqenɛeɣ belli Netta aqa ɣares ṣṣulṭa, maḥend ad iḥḍa i necc aḍman inu ař ass nni.
Ejj ad ɣarek iqqim lmital n wawařen iṣeḥḥen i zzayi tesřid s l’iman d tayri i iǧan di Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Ḥḍa aḍman aṣebḥan i d ac ittwawekkřen s Arruḥ Iqeddsen nni dayneɣ izeddɣen.
Aqa tessned belli marra inni iǧan di Asiya jjin ayi, zzaysen Fixilus d Hirmuxinis.
Ad yarzef Siditneɣ s arreḥmet di taddart n Unisifurus, minzi tuɣa issareyyeḥ ayi aṭṭas n twařawin uca war iseḍḥi ca zi ssnaseř n tmeḥbast inu.
Maɣar řami dd-yusa ɣar Ruma, tuɣa yarezzu xafi s cḍaret aṭṭas uca yufa ayi.
Ad as iwc Siditneɣ, aqa ad yaf arreḥmet ɣar Siditneɣ deg wass nni. Uca mecḥař isexxar ayi di Afasus, cek tessned ktar.
